lines.10: Crab cried easily, so that had to hurt.
lines.14: 「Whoa. Look at her. She's smiling a little at Crab's teary face.」
lines.15: 「No thanks. She's the kind I can't stand. More importantly, let's stop Crab. She's gonna snap in two seconds.」
lines.17: 「You little... Dying under the sunset isn't a bad way to go, huh?!」
lines.18: Subaru and I each grabbed Crab from one side.
lines.21: 「Who the hell is Suzuki, dumbasses?! Let me go! I'm gonna take her out!」
